style_en: Japanese TV anime style, crisp clean line art, cel-shaded coloring, calm muted colors, slightly dim lighting, a faint washi-paper texture. The same art style in every episode. The main subject is in the center of the picture.
avoid_en: any text, letters, numbers, logos, modern buildings or clothes, Chinese-style clothing, nudity, blood

amaterasu.desc_en: Amaterasu, the sun goddess, a serene young woman with very long straight black hair and a thin golden circlet, white and gold Kofun-period robe with a long white mo skirt, a magatama bead necklace, a soft golden glow around her

ookuninushi.desc_en: Okuninushi, the ruler of Izumo, a gentle tired man in his 50s with a short black beard streaked with gray, black hair in mizura loops, a deep indigo Kofun-period robe with white trousers, a large green magatama necklace

cuts.image: 暗い社の中、長く広げられた古い巻物の上に、たくさんの光る名札のような光の粒が浮かぶ、灯明、文字は読めない、人はいない
cuts.image_en: Inside a dark ancient Japanese shrine, a long old scroll is unrolled on the floor and many small glowing lights float above it like name tags, lamplight; any writing is blurred and unreadable. No people. The scroll and lights are in the center.
cuts.en: Inside a dark ancient Japanese shrine, a long old scroll is unrolled on the floor and many small glowing lights float above it like name tags, lamplight; any writing is blurred and unreadable. No people. The scroll and lights are in the center.

cuts.image: 暗闇の中、炎に包まれて生まれる小さな火の神の赤ん坊、まわりに火の粉が渦を巻く、画面の真ん中、血は描かない
cuts.image_en: In the darkness, a small baby fire god is born wrapped in swirling flames, sparks spiraling around, in the center of the picture, no blood.
cuts.en: In the darkness, a small baby fire god is born wrapped in swirling flames, sparks spiraling around, in the center of the picture, no blood.

cuts.image: 朝日の昇る雲の上に立つ太陽の女神、まわりに金色の光の輪、画面の真ん中に大きく
cuts.image_en: The sun goddess stands on clouds as the morning sun rises, a ring of golden light around her, large in the center of the picture.
cuts.en: The sun goddess stands on clouds as the morning sun rises, a ring of golden light around her, large in the center of the picture.

cuts.image: 出雲の海辺の夕暮れ、穏やかな顔の大国主が立ち、その背後に少しずつ姿の違う同じ神の影が4つ並んで重なる、画面の真ん中
cuts.image_en: Dusk on the Izumo seashore: Okuninushi stands with a gentle face, and behind him four shadowy figures of the same god, each slightly different in look, stand overlapping in a row, in the center of the picture.
cuts.en: Dusk on the Izumo seashore: Okuninushi stands with a gentle face, and behind him four shadowy figures of the same god, each slightly different in look, stand overlapping in a row, in the center of the picture.

cuts.image: 夕暮れの日本の山と野を空から見た景色、あちこちの村に小さな社の灯りがともり、点々と広がる、人はいない
cuts.image_en: An aerial view of the mountains and fields of ancient Japan at dusk, small shrine lights glowing in villages here and there, spreading out like dots. No people.
cuts.en: An aerial view of the mountains and fields of ancient Japan at dusk, small shrine lights glowing in villages here and there, spreading out like dots. No people.
